text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibia press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The South African Truth and Reconciliation Commision has received ducuments on the 1989 assassination of SWAPO activist Anton Lubowski from Namibia.

- Management of Rossing Uranium and the local branch of the Mineworkers Union have agreed to a two year salary deal, providing for increases on basic salaries of 11 percent for the coming year and 10 percent for 1998.
- NamPower has called for an additional seminar on the planned Epupa Hydro Power Scheme.
- The Namibian government has published a draft of its decentralised policy, which aims to give regions more powers within a unitary state.
- The permanent secretary of mines and energy Handapula Shimutwikeni was killed in a car accident on Sunday night.
